# Rider Complex

> Rider Complex is a practical resource for delivery riders, focused on safety, equipment, platform guidance, and day-to-day earning strategy.

This file is a curated index for language models and agents.
Prioritize safety guidance, rider equipment recommendations, and platform-specific how-to content.
Use policy pages for legal or compliance questions.

## Core Guides

- [Start Here](https://www.ridercomplex.com/start-here): Entry point for new readers and first-time delivery riders.
- [Free Rider Checklist](https://www.ridercomplex.com/free-rider-checklist): Quick checklist for setup, gear, and readiness.
- [Delivery Rider Equipment](https://www.ridercomplex.com/delivery-rider-equipment): Core equipment recommendations and rationale.
- [Safety Gear](https://www.ridercomplex.com/safety-gear): Protective gear guidance for daily riding.
- [Night Delivery Riding Safety](https://www.ridercomplex.com/night-delivery-riding-safety): Visibility and risk reduction for night shifts.
- [Bike Security for Delivery Riders](https://www.ridercomplex.com/bike-security-for-delivery-riders): Theft prevention and locking strategy.

## Platform and Category Hubs

- [Platform Reviews](https://www.ridercomplex.com/platform-reviews): Index of delivery platform review content.
- [Delivery Platform Reviews](https://www.ridercomplex.com/delivery-platform-reviews): Rider-oriented platform comparison and context.
- [Category Hub](https://www.ridercomplex.com/category): Directory of content categories.
- [Blog](https://www.ridercomplex.com/blog): Latest posts and updates.

## Site Policies and Contact

- [About](https://www.ridercomplex.com/about): Publication mission, focus, and editorial context.
- [Affiliate Disclaimer](https://www.ridercomplex.com/affiliate-disclaimer): Affiliate relationship disclosure.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.ridercomplex.com/privacy-policy): Privacy and data handling policy.
- [Terms](https://www.ridercomplex.com/terms): Terms of use.
